states.description: Person is sitting at the desk, initially looking at phone or preparing to eat.

rules.action: Pick up the cup and place it next to the person.
Pick up the bowl and place it next to the person.

next.on: Person places a bowl on the desk.

states.description: Person is eating at the desk.

rules.action: Pick up the bowl and place it in the dishwasher.
Pick up the cup and place it in the dishwasher.

states.description: Person is leaving the desk area to turn off lights.

rules.trigger: Person walks to the light switch.

states.description: Person is in bed, looking at phone.

rules.trigger: Person puts the phone on the bed.

next.on: Person turns off the bedside lamp.

states.description: Person is in bed, lights are off.
